title: Finishing Options for Custom Printed Boxes
excerpt: Explore matte lamination, gloss lamination, soft touch, foil stamping, embossing, debossing and spot UV for premium packaging.
coverAlt: Print operator checking colour on a press with colour charts

sections.heading: Matte and gloss lamination
sections.body: Matte lamination gives a smooth premium look, while gloss lamination creates a shiny and bright surface. Both options can protect the printed surface.

sections.heading: Foil stamping
sections.body: Foil stamping adds metallic detail in gold, silver, copper or custom colors. It is commonly used on logos, patterns and luxury packaging details.

sections.heading: Embossing and debossing
sections.body: Embossing raises the design above the surface, while debossing presses the design into the surface. Both add a premium tactile effect.

sections.heading: Spot UV
sections.body: Spot UV highlights selected areas with a glossy raised effect. It works well on logos, product names and decorative design elements.

faqs.question: Which finish is best for luxury boxes?
faqs.answer: Soft touch lamination, foil stamping, embossing, debossing and spot UV are popular for luxury boxes.

faqs.question: Can multiple finishes be used together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many premium packaging projects combine lamination with foil, embossing or spot UV depending on design and material.
